hero.title: Track your anime and manga in Discord
hero.description: Tantei watches your MyAnimeList, AniList and Shikimori activity and posts every episode you watch, chapter you read and rating you leave into the Discord servers you share with it.

error.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled before Discord could confirm it.
error.expired: The sign-in attempt took too long and expired. Please try again.

signInPrompt.title: Sign in to see your details
signInPrompt.description: Sign in with Discord to see how Tantei tracks you and which servers it posts your updates in.

registered.explanation: Tantei only tracks people who have signed up through the bot's commands in Discord. Run the bot's sign-up command in a server it is in, and your list activity will show up here.

guilds.title: Servers the bot posts your updates in
guilds.empty: The bot is not posting your updates in any server yet.

invite.title: Add Tantei to a server
invite.unavailable: Tantei could not check your servers with Discord just now. Try again in a moment, or sign in again if this keeps happening.
invite.empty: Tantei is already in every server you manage.

notice.private: Only the bot's owner can add Tantei to a server, so signing in will not let you add it to yours.
notice.semiPrivate: You can add Tantei to a server you manage only if you are already in a server it is in.

blocked.private: Only the bot's owner can add Tantei to a server.
blocked.semiPrivate: To add Tantei to a server you manage, you need to be in a server Tantei is already in.

apiPing.title: API wiring check
apiPing.description: Calls {endpoint} on the backend through Vite's dev proxy.
